verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data platform with a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to disable telemetry or usage tracking in the workspace, CLI, SDKs or Genie Code. The only related items describe Unity Catalog activity logging for auditing and a SOC 2 attestation, and neither is an opt-out mechanism.
